program: Wingless external raw-input to repaired prediction to fixed refined abstract reasoning probability/source attribution
question: Are the residual hidden exact-repair gains primarily near-miss probability geometry and source-specific effects rather than missing relation or readout capacity?
hypothesis: Without changing the sealed 512-motif representation, repaired relation, eight fixed 64-motif classes, runtime cap, horizons, or any learned/readout capacity, re-evaluate the exact 49 hidden depth-3 repair-gain rows from R2. For the frozen 30 cross-class rows, at least 0.75 will place the truth class within the top two repaired class-probability masses, and the absolute difference between code and structured cross-class hidden-gain rates will be at least 0.20. This would localize the remaining failure to probability-boundary geometry plus source specificity rather than justify capacity growth.

prior_evidence.diagnosis: R2 rejected same-class geometry as the primary explanation while showing stable truth-class mass on 47/49 hidden gains. The bounded next step is probability-rank and source-rate attribution only.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.refined_readout: byte-identical fixed eight training-rank classes of 64 motifs each

attribution_protocol.primary_population: the exact 49 R2 heldout depth-3 hidden exact-repair gain rows
attribution_protocol.cross_class_population: the exact 30 R2 rows classified cross-class
probability_geometry: repaired truth-class probability rank among the eight fixed classes
repaired top-class mass minus repaired truth-class mass
source_specificity: cross-class hidden-gain rate within each source hidden-gain population
attribution_protocol.selection_data: none; attribution is post hoc over frozen heldout scoring rows only

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes and both frozen attribution thresholds pass: at least 0.75 of cross-class hidden gains rank the truth class in the repaired top two, and the code-versus-structured cross-class rate gap is at least 0.20.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and exactly one of the two attribution thresholds passes.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but neither attribution threshold passes.
classification_rules.invalid: Any sealed-parent, authority, source, frozen-readout, population-accounting, determinism, capacity, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.

validity_criteria: Exact qualified mixed R2 parent and North Star identities match.
Fresh READY_RESEARCH is bound to this exact preregistration and external manifest.
Representation, baseline relation, repaired relation, eight class assignments, support threshold, runtime cap, and horizons are unchanged.
The 49-row hidden-gain population and 30-row cross-class subset reproduce R2 exactly before new attribution metrics are accepted.
Attribution introduces no learned state, adaptive thresholds, labels for selection, or additional readout capacity.
Heldout data is used only to score and categorize already-frozen predictions.
Duplicate complete probes are byte-identical and all attribution rows account exactly once.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, relation repair, class boundaries, runtime cap, horizons, hidden populations, top-two definition, 0.75 top-two floor, 0.20 source-rate-gap floor, metrics, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: test one preregistered training-only fixed probability-margin rule with unchanged class count and relation capacity

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: factor the residual by source and class transition before any capacity change
